en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Abdul Kareem, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘
A waiting period of the woman divorced by Al-Khul’a is similar to a waiting period of the divorced woman, and her Khul’a is her divorce’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Nasr from ‘Abd al-Karim from ibn abu Nasr who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
waiting period for al-Khul‘ is like the waiting period for divorced woman and al-Khul‘ is her divorce.’”
